Round 3.14159 to the nearest whole number
```{r}
round(3.14159)
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```
Ordering arguments
```{r}
print(rep(5,7))
print(rep(times=7,x=5))
```
```{r}
my_variable <- 12
my_variable <- 10
print(my_variable)
```
Identifying types of variables
```{r}
x<- "hi there"
print(class(x))
```
